UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile synchronized from Google Sign-In.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the navigation bar.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

FavoriteMovie.title: FavoriteMovie
FavoriteMovie.description: A movie saved to the authenticated user's personal favorites list.

userId.description: Owner UID matching the parent user document.

imgURL.description: Poster image URL for the movie.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the movie was added to favorites.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile owned strictly by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{movieId}.description: User's favorite movies subcollection scoped strictly to the owner.
